title: Delete confirm: an object can word its Delete confirmation, or the confirmation names what a cascade will delete
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27380 said: take what is ui-only, card the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `5f6dc96c` (report 6517004938, `out_of_scope_findings`). Row 1 is taken in PR #27996.
Reach: deleting a record whose children cascade. HotCRM: deleting a lead silently deletes its campaign memberships (#27380 row 4).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` for triage first. The two shapes below land differently, and triage picks one.
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "delete confirmation confirmText override cascade delete children warning" → #27823 (closed: "permanent" wording and record naming) and #20006 (closed, a different gap).

## Observed
`RowCrudActionOverrideSchema` (`packages/spec` `data/object.zod.ts`) declares only `enabled` / `visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen`, so an object cannot word its Delete confirmation, and nothing names the cascade.

## Wanted (triage picks one)
- **A (smaller):** a `confirmText` key on the delete override, with the count / record holes that bulk actions gained in #25942. The row delete and record page delete confirms read it. Lanes: `domain:spec` then `domain:ui`.
- **B (always true, no author work; the card thread recommends it):** the confirmation adds a generated line naming the child objects whose reference carries `deleteBehavior: cascade` (master_detail included, per the engine's delete semantics). The client gets that list from the server (object metadata or a delete preview), never from a second copy of the engine rule. Lanes: `domain:server` then `domain:ui`.
- Landing on the ui side: `plugin-grid` `rowCrudAffordances` / `ObjectGrid` delete and the record page delete confirm.

Dedupe words: delete confirmText override, cascade delete warning, delete confirmation children, RowCrudActionOverride confirm, deleteBehavior cascade confirm.

Related: #27380 (row 4), #25942, #27823.
